lines.t: You kept loving me when my loyalty ran dry
You kept chasing me as I broke down and cried
You filled my weary soul when I had nothing left
Thank you for your work that brought me to my rest
You knew my hidden tremble, the bruise beneath my pride
You never mocked the weakness, you just stood there by my side
Each deception that I trusted
Crumbled gently in your hands, I was swaying like a reed
But you made me stand again
You searched what I kept buried, unafraid of what you'd find
Love pursuing every piece I tried to leave behind
You kept loving me when all my loyalty ran dry
You kept chasing me as I broke down and cried
You filled my weary soul when I had nothing left
Thank you for your work, that brought me to my rest
Not with thunder, not with fire, but a voice that would not fade
Not demanding that I be worthy, only asking I be saved
In the moment I surrendered all my running, lost his claim
I fell into the arms that had been following me
All the way
You kept loving me
When my loyalty ran dry
You kept chasing me
As I broke down and cried
You filled my weary soul
When I had nothing left
Thank you for your work
That brought me to my rest
You kept coming after me
And all I can say
Is praise
You kept coming here
Ooh, you kept coming
And now I'm falling home
Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh
Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh
